mapper.select: SELECT * FROM schema_risk.risk_profile WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM schema_risk.risk_profile WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} ORDER BY generated_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schema_risk.risk_profile (application_id, enterprise_id, version, supply_chain_score, transaction_score, material_score, weighted_config_id, overall_score, risk_level, risk_reasons, suggestions, content_hash) VALUES (#{applicationId}, #{enterpriseId}, #{version}, #{supplyChainScore}, #{transactionScore}, #{materialScore}, #{weightedConfigId}, #{overallScore}, #{riskLevel}, CAST(#{riskReasons, typeHandler=com.scfs.common.mybatis.JsonListTypeHandler} AS jsonb), CAST(#{suggestions, typeHandler=com.scfs.common.mybatis.JsonListTypeHandler} AS jsonb), #{contentHash})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM schema_risk.transaction_stability WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} ORDER BY calculated_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schema_risk.transaction_stability (enterprise_id, score, transaction_count_12m, amount_std_dev, trend_data) VALUES (#{enterpriseId}, #{score}, #{transactionCount12m}, #{amountStdDev}, CAST(#{trendData, typeHandler=com.scfs.common.mybatis.JsonListTypeHandler} AS jsonb))
mapper.update: UPDATE schema_risk.transaction_stability SET score = #{score}, transaction_count_12m = #{transactionCount12m}, amount_std_dev = #{amountStdDev}, trend_data = CAST(#{trendData, typeHandler=com.scfs.common.mybatis.JsonListTypeHandler} AS jsonb), calculated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
